highlights: Review proposed file changes in the app: browse them, read feedback, edit comments, and ask the agent about specific changed lines.
The redesigned sidebar lets you organize tasks, reorder pinned tasks, and find tasks and project files faster.
Attach general files and images more easily, preview images and videos, and save unfinished prompts with their attachments for later.
New plugins connect to UC San Diego Kuali Build and n8n, using your own sign-in or API key and only the permissions you authorize.
If you enable computer use, the app can work on your desktop with visible setup and activity. App updates also install more reliably.
You can now download and install app updates from inside the app, with progress, release notes, and an automatic restart.
Each model now uses the correct account key, and you can replace or remove keys without restarting the app.
Signing in to add-ons such as GitHub, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365 is easier and more flexible.
When the app asks you to approve work, you now see complete details, including full proposed file changes.
Small fixes make the app more stable and polished, with a refreshed look and better voice input on Mac.
Memory now keeps daily notes of your work by default, and you can optionally sync them between your computers through OneDrive.
New chats now start with the Flash model, and GPT-6.1 Sol is among the updated cloud models.
Finished tasks are now marked Done, and you can reopen them if you want to continue.
On Windows, the app no longer opens an extra console window when it works with your desktop applications.

setup: To update the app, open Settings, then About, and choose Check for Updates.
faq: Computer use is off by default; turn it on in Settings under General if you want the agent to work with local applications.
New tasks start in Full access, where the agent works without asking. Pick a different mode before sending if you want approvals first.
privacy: Memory is on by default and keeps daily notes of your conversations on your own computer. You can turn it off under Settings, General, Memory.
Syncing notes to your other computers through OneDrive is optional. Turn it on under Settings, General, Memory, and sign in with your UC San Diego account.
skills: Find reusable skills for recurring work in TritonAI Commons, the public skill library under Settings, Skills.
citizen: Bring back a prompt you already sent by pressing the up arrow in an empty message box.
If you want the agent to pause for your approval before changing files, choose Supervised mode before sending your task.
models: Check which access key is in use under Settings, Runtime. It shows only the last four characters, so the full key stays hidden.
To replace an access key, choose Change key, enter the new one, and pick Check access and save. The connection briefly restarts afterward.
